gameName: Harry Potter: Hogwarts Battle – Defence Against the Dark Arts

provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Defence Against the Dark Arts rulebook (USAopoly, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Practice Mat lengthwise between the players, tokens nearby
Each player chooses a House (may be the same): House card in front of you, mover on START on your side
Shuffle the Hogwarts cards; reveal {n} faceup along the mat as the Classroom
Book cards faceup as the Library
Each player: 7 Alohomora!, 1 Wand, 1 Cauldron + one Ally (Cat, Toad or Owl); box the other Allies
Stun your opponent three times to win
Library cards can be acquired whenever you could acquire from the Classroom
First turn: resolve Hex cards, then play cards
